points: Preheat your oven to 220°C/200°C fan/gas mark 7.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Pop a deep saucepan (with a tight-fitting lid) on medium heat with the oil (see pantry for amount). Once hot, add half the garlic and stir-fry for 1 min.
Stir in the rice until coated, 1 min. Add 1/4 tsp salt and the water for the rice (see pantry for amount) and bring to the boil.
steps.title: Start the Garlic Rice

points: Once the rice is boiling, turn the heat down to medium and cover with the lid.
Leave to cook for 10 mins, then remove the pan from the heat (still covered) and leave to the side for another 10 mins or until ready to serve (the rice will continue to cook in its own steam).
steps.title: Finish the Rice

points: Meanwhile, lay the salmon fillets, skin-side down, onto a lined baking tray. Season with salt and pepper, then rub to coat.
When the oven is hot, roast the salmon on the top shelf until cooked through, 10-15 mins.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw fish. It's cooked when opaque in the middle.

steps.title: Roast the Salmon

points: While the salmon roasts, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the pea pods and mushrooms to the pan and stir-fry until tender, 5-6 mins.
Add the remaining garlic and stir-fry until fragrant, 30 secs.
Stir in the soy sauce until evaporated, 1 min. Transfer the cooked veg to a bowl and cover to keep warm.
steps.title: Get Stir-Frying

points: When everything's nearly ready, clean out the (now empty) frying pan and pop back on medium heat.
Add the hot sauce, honey, butter and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts) and stir vigorously until the butter has melted and the sauce is piping hot, 1-2 mins.

notes.text: If your honey has hardened, put the sachet in a bowl of hot water for 1 min to loosen.

steps.title: Hot Honey Time

points: Fluff up the garlic rice with a fork and share between your serving bowls.
Top with the salmon and soy stir-fried veg. Spoon the hot honey sauce over the salmon fillets.
Drizzle over the mayonnaise (see pantry for amount) to finish.
steps.title: Serve Up
